packMeta.name: CounterFlow (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey retail store operations hub around the till: product catalogue with live margins and quick stock adjustments, audited stock ledger, floor tasks, suppliers, staff roster, and customer returns desk. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
